capabilities: Browse and filter the card pool
Build and validate decks against game rules
Track match results and win rates
Generate deck and tournament notes from templates
Render inline card references and images
disambiguation: Not a time-tracking or version-history tool; it manages cards, decks and matches for the ChronoCCG card game.
extras: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Chronoverse Games Studio; requires Obsidian 1.14.4 or later; mobile is untested with rough edges expected; only downloads card data, images and syndicate icons from the official CDN and sends no vault data; MIT license covers the plugin code only.
motivation: The author wanted to keep decks and tournament reports in the vault with real cards instead of plain text.
problem: Obsidian has no way to store card game decks with real cards, validate them against game rules, or track match results.

relations.evidence: ChronoVault is an Obsidian plugin for ChronoCCG.

summary: Obsidian plugin for the ChronoCCG card game that browses cards, builds and validates decks, and tracks matches and tournaments.
